limitations: Unknown country/market are retained as UNKNOWN, never inferred.
This enriched cohort estimates cohort performance, not population prevalence.
Independent review and adjudication required; no AI labels are golden.
Frozen test membership is public for audit; training code excludes its entire groups.
sampling: Deterministic greedy marginal diversity with rare strata and low-confidence/restriction/conflict oversampling; one excerpt per duplicate/filing group. Not a population-random sample.
